children: US regional bank's Q3 net income rose yr/yr, driven by higher net interest and non-interest income
Company's results aided by gains on sale of real estate and fixed assets
Higher provision for credit losses and non-interest expense partly offset income gains
Company did not provide specific guidance for future quarters or the full year in its press release
NET INTEREST INCOME - Co said net interest income rose 12.2% yr/yr, driven by higher interest income from loans and investment securities
NON-INTEREST INCOME - Co said non-interest income rose 31.2% yr/yr, mainly due to gains on sale of real estate and fixed assets
CREDIT LOSS PROVISION - Co said provision for credit losses increased 539.5% yr/yr, partly offsetting income gains
